name: The Border

features.name: xBomb Wilds
features.description: Clear neighbours and raise the multiplier.

review:
The Border is a 6x6 cluster slot with nearly every xMechanic. Clusters of five or more win and are destroyed, and xBomb Wilds clear neighbouring symbols and add +1 to the multiplier for the next collapse. Boosted xRip ensures a scatter on reel 1 for 50% extra.

xWays, xSplit, xNudge and xCluster all appear. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 44,288x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
